#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long r = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = r * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;

    long long invm = modPow(m, MOD - 2);

    vector<long long> dp(k + 1, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;

    for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
        for (int d = k - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
            long long cur = dp[d];
            if (cur == 0) continue;
            dp[d + 1] = (dp[d + 1] + cur * (n - d)) % MOD;
            dp[d] = cur * d % MOD;
        }
    }

    long long p = 1, ans = 0;
    for (int d = 1; d <= k; d++) {
        p = p * invm % MOD;
        ans = (ans + dp[d] * p) % MOD;
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
